limitations: Emulator evidence only; hardware acceptance pending.

Fast can miss any same-size BIN edit, including when pages moved between launches: it stores no historical physical addresses. Only address changes later within the current run trigger a recheck. The existing unused-header-byte test demonstrates one same-size blind spot.
Full tests use file-map and menu-VRAM stress; raw timing is not a controlled hardware benchmark.
Preserves the minimal Loader shell, not arbitrary caller stack/heap/resources; no general A-to-B-to-A API claim.
Current emulator may log handled guest TLB misses in its error field; these also occur in the prior baseline and did not prevent gameplay or normal cleanup.
The ordinary backend remains limited to the OS 512-page / 2 MiB mapping window.

changes: Cross-check APP.MET image size against APP.FPF before allocating the backend.
Clarify that Fast has no historical physical addresses and may miss any same-size BIN edits across launches.
